item.title: Pokémon Pokopia's Roots Go Back Further Than You Think
item.description: From Hoenn, with love.Pokémon Pokopia is a strange little concept. It's a life sim set in the Pokémon world where you, a humanoid Ditto, set out to rebuild a fallen civilisation with the help of your pocket monster pals. Weird, right? Where could the inspiration for that possibly have stemmed from? item.title: Jurassic Park: Classic Games Collection To Be Delisted Just Two Years After Release
item.description: Extinction.Just over two years after it was released on Switch and other platforms, Limited Run Games' Jurassic Park: Classic Games Collection is getting delisted from digital storefronts. The publisher and distributor announced the news on Steam (thanks Wario64) earlier today.From 31st March 2026, you'll no longer be able to purchase the game digitally. item.title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! Brings A "New Retro FPS" Experience To Switch 2 This March
item.description: Update: Release date confirmed in new gameplay trailer.If you're a fan of retro-style first-person shooters and want to eradicate swarms of alien bugs, you might want to check out this new game when it arrives in early 2026.Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! is developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) and published by Dotemu (Marvel Cosmic Invasion), and will be coming to the Switch 2 and multiple other platforms.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
